refnamediv.refpurpose: Delete a pointer that represent mesh2.

varlistentry.listitem: : is a pointer representing mesh2 to be deleted.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Given a pointer ptr of mesh2, mesh2_delete(ptr,"ptr") frees the memory hold by the pointer ptr and clears ptr in Scialb interpreter. If no parameters are given to mesh2_delete(), then all pointers of differents mesh2 will be deleted.
